eventtitle: AWS Data Foundations Powers AI-Driven Legal Search Transformation
description: Singapore Academy of Law revolutionizes legal research using AWS's AI and analytics services. Their solution combines Amazon OpenSearch Service's hybrid search—merging vector and full-text capabilities with fine-tuned embeddings—alongside GPTLegal, a fine-tuned model for legal Q&A built using Amazon SageMaker AI. AWS Glue ETL pipelines process data within Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio, while Amazon Quick delivers actionable insights. The breakthrough Legal Research Assistant orchestrates multiple AI tools with Bedrock AgentCore, leveraging Amazon Bedrock's foundation models for intelligent responses and implementing responsible AI through Bedrock Guardrails. This production-ready architecture demonstrates the future of conversational legal research at scale.
